description: Header file defining the LoadBalancerEncoder class and related interfaces for QUIC load balancing, including configuration management and connection ID encoding.

classes.name: LoadBalancerEncoder
classes.description: Manages QUIC load balancer configurations and encodes server IDs into connection IDs, supporting configuration updates and unroutable ID generation.

classes.name: LoadBalancerEncoderVisitorInterface
classes.description: Interface for receiving notifications about load balancer configuration changes.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new LoadBalancerEncoder instance with no active config, given parameters.

methods.name: UpdateConfig
methods.description: Replaces current config and server ID; returns false if invalid.

methods.name: DeleteConfig
methods.description: Deletes current config and switches to unroutable connection ID generation.

methods.name: GenerateConnectionId
methods.description: Generates a connection ID based on current config or unroutable ID if none.
